name: SoftVoltAI Voice Agent
author: SoftVoltAI

sections.description:
SoftVoltAI Voice Agent is an AI chatbot with a built-in voice assistant for WordPress. It works like an AI receptionist and sales agent on every page of your site: visitors talk or type, it answers from your own business facts, recommends the right service or product, books the appointment, and sends you every lead by email, Telegram or n8n.

It does more than answer questions: it asks one question at a time, recommends what fits, collects the details you choose and books the job. When a visitor would rather speak to a person, it hands them over as a hot lead, with a note of what they wanted and what it already explained. Every booking and hand-off is saved in WordPress before any alert is sent, so a lead is kept even if an email or message fails.

An AI chatbot you can talk to

The voice agent listens and speaks through the speech features already built into the visitor’s browser. There is no speech service to pay for. It understands and answers in 31 languages, from English to Bengali, Arabic, Spanish, Hindi and Japanese. Browsers without voice support simply get the text chat, so every visitor can use it.

An AI receptionist for bookings and appointments

For a plumber, a clinic, a salon or a consultant, it works like a virtual assistant at the front desk: it asks what the visitor needs, where and when, collects a phone number or email, confirms the details and saves the appointment request. You get it straight away, with the whole conversation.

A WooCommerce chatbot that shows real products

In a WooCommerce store the agent searches your live products and shows them as cards with the price, stock and an Add to cart button. New products and price changes are used the moment you save them. Customers pay at your normal checkout.

Lead generation around the clock

  • Qualifies every enquiry and captures the lead, even at night.
  • Hands hot leads to a person when a visitor asks, stays unsure, or asks something it cannot answer.
  • Keeps every lead in a Leads inbox with its status, your notes and the conversation, ready to export as CSV.
  • Alerts you by email (replies go straight to the visitor), by Telegram through your own bot, or as JSON to n8n, Make or Zapier.

Free AI models, or your own key

Start on a free AI model: OpenRouter’s free models, Groq’s free plan or Google Gemini’s free tier. When the leads justify it, move to DeepSeek, OpenAI (GPT) or Anthropic Claude for sharper answers, or any OpenAI-compatible service, including a model you run yourself. Each provider comes with step-by-step instructions for getting a key and a Test connection button.

On WordPress 7.0 or later you can instead choose WordPress AI connection: the agent uses the AI provider you connected under Settings > Connectors, with no second key to paste.

Answers from your facts

  • It is told to use only the services, prices, questions and pages you add, and not to make up prices or promises.
  • Replies are checked before the visitor sees them: a price that is not in your facts, your shop or the conversation is caught, and the agent answers again from your data.
  • Learn from my site reads your About, Services, FAQ and Contact pages, your shop and your booking plugin, and fills in the agent’s knowledge for you to check.
  • During a chat it can search your published pages, so answers about opening hours or delivery match what your site says.

Fits any kind of site

  • Services or agency: qualifies the enquiry and books a call or a project.
  • Local service or appointments: asks what the problem is, where and when, and books an appointment. A phone number is enough.
  • Online shop: recommends products from your WooCommerce store, with cards and an Add to cart button.
  • Information, blog or community: answers questions from your pages and takes enquiries.

Place it anywhere, with drag and drop

  • A floating chat button in any corner: drag it into place in the live preview.
  • A button in your header menu, chosen from your theme’s menu locations.
  • The “Voice Agent Button” block, for any page or a block theme’s header and footer.
  • The “Voice Agent Button” widget for classic sidebars and footers.
  • A “Voice Agent” menu item, or any link to #svava-open.
  • One shortcode for everything else, including Elementor and other page builders: [softvoltai_voice_agent]

A dashboard that shows what matters

One screen shows whether the agent is live, new leads, messages per day, the latest leads, and a health check that points to anything that needs fixing: the AI connection, HTTPS for voice, alerts, placement and your shop. Press Talk to your agent to try it the way a visitor would.

Private and careful

  • API keys are stored encrypted and never reach the visitor’s browser.
  • Leads are private: only administrators can see, edit or export them.
  • A limit per visitor and a daily cap protect your AI credit.
  • Works with WordPress’s personal-data export and erase tools, and adds suggested text to your privacy policy.

External services

The plugin connects to outside services only as described here.

The AI provider you choose

Needed to write the agent’s replies. Each time a visitor sends a message (and when you press “Test connection”), the plugin sends the provider: the instructions built from your settings (your business details, services, questions and pages), the visitor’s message, the recent conversation, and the results of any search the agent makes of your published pages or products. Nothing is sent until you choose a provider and add its key.

  • OpenRouter: terms, privacy. When you press “Show every free model”, the plugin also downloads the public model list from openrouter.ai; nothing is sent with that request.
  • Groq: terms, privacy
  • Google Gemini API: terms, privacy
  • DeepSeek: terms, privacy
  • OpenAI: terms, privacy
  • Anthropic (Claude): terms, privacy
  • Any other OpenAI-compatible address you enter yourself.
  • WordPress AI connection: if you choose it, the same information goes through the WordPress AI Client to the provider you connected under Settings > Connectors, under that provider’s terms and privacy policy. The plugin never handles that key.

Telegram

Only if you turn on Telegram alerts. When a lead is saved (or you send a test), the alert text with the lead’s details is sent to api.telegram.org through your own bot. Terms, privacy.

Your webhook (n8n, Make, Zapier or other)

Only if you turn on the webhook. When a lead is saved (or you send a test), the lead’s details are sent as JSON to the address you enter, with your secret header.

SoftVoltAI model suggestions

Only if you tick the weekly check or press “Check now” on the Advanced tab. The plugin downloads https://www.softvoltai.com/voice-agent/catalog.json, a list of suggested models and setup guides. No information about your site or its visitors is sent. Terms, privacy.

SoftVoltAI store (n8n Templates page)

Only when you open AI Voice Agent > n8n Templates. Your browser loads the public list of n8n templates and their workflow pictures from https://products.softvoltai.com. No information about your site or its visitors is sent. Terms, privacy.

Speech in the visitor’s browser

Voice uses the Web Speech API built into the visitor’s browser. The plugin sends no audio anywhere, but some browsers (for example Chrome) use their maker’s online speech service to turn speech into text.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Open AI Voice Agent: the dashboard shows the four setup steps. Then open AI Voice Agent > Settings.
  3. AI model: choose a provider, follow the steps to get a key, paste it, and press Test connection. On WordPress 7.0 or later you can instead choose WordPress AI connection to use the provider you connected under Settings > Connectors.
  4. Knowledge: add your business, services, prices and common questions.
  5. Alerts: choose where new leads go and send a test.
  6. Look & placement: the floating button is on by default. Drag it where you want it, or place the block, widget, menu button or shortcode.

Until an AI provider is set up, only administrators see the agent.
sections.faq:
Is this a free AI chatbot for WordPress?

Yes. The plugin is free and complete, with no locked features. With a free AI model (OpenRouter, Groq or Google Gemini’s free tier) it costs nothing to run. With a paid provider you pay that provider directly for what you use.

Can it work as an AI receptionist and book appointments?

Yes. Choose “Local service or appointments” on the Knowledge tab: the agent asks what the visitor needs, where and when, collects a phone number or email, confirms the details and saves the appointment request, then alerts you by email, Telegram or n8n.

How does it know what my site sells?

Choose your kind of site on the Knowledge tab (a shop, a local service, an agency, a blog…) and press Learn from my site: it reads your pages and your shop and proposes what the agent should know. You check it, change anything, and save. With WooCommerce, the agent searches your live products during the chat, so new products and prices are used straight away.

Is it a WooCommerce chatbot?

Yes. In a WooCommerce store it searches your live products during the chat and shows them as cards with the price, stock and an Add to cart button.

Does it take payments?

No. In a shop it adds products to the cart, and customers pay at your own checkout. For a service it saves a booking or appointment request and alerts you.

Can I use OpenAI, Google Gemini, Claude or DeepSeek?

Yes. Choose OpenAI (GPT), Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, DeepSeek, Groq, OpenRouter or any OpenAI-compatible service on the AI model tab, paste the key and press Test connection. You can switch at any time.

Which AI model should I choose?

To try it, start with a free one, such as Groq’s free plan. For a business site, a low-cost paid model such as DeepSeek Flash is a good place to start. Test a few with your own questions and keep the one that suits you; you can switch at any time.

Can it use the AI I connected in WordPress?

Yes, on WordPress 7.0 or later. Connect a provider (for example Google, OpenAI or Anthropic) under Settings > Connectors, then choose WordPress AI connection on the AI model tab. WordPress keeps the key; the plugin never sees it. Leave the model on Automatic and a fast model is chosen for you.

Is there a Pro version?

Voice Agent Pro is a separate add-on, available at https://products.softvoltai.com/pricing/: training on your business goals, multiple agents, natural voices, calendar booking, payments in the chat, WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram and Telegram, a live inbox, analytics, CRM integrations, an API and ready-made n8n templates. Everything in this plugin stays free and keeps working without it. You can try Pro free for 3 days, and AI credits, sold separately, let a Pro site answer without an AI key of your own. The Pro page in the plugin lists what Pro adds.

Does voice cost anything?

No. Speech is handled by the visitor’s browser, not by a paid speech service. Only the text of the conversation goes to your AI provider.

Which browsers support voice?

Chrome, Edge and Safari on computers and phones. In other browsers the text chat works as normal. Your site must use HTTPS for the microphone.

The microphone does not work on my site.

Check that the site uses HTTPS. Some security plugins or hosts send a Permissions-Policy header that blocks the microphone; it must allow microphone=(self).

Where are leads stored?

In your own WordPress database, under AI Voice Agent > Leads, with the conversation that led to them. You can set a status, add notes and export them as CSV.

How do I put the button in my header?

Classic themes: choose a menu location under Look & placement, or add the “Voice Agent” item in Appearance > Menus. Block themes: drag the “Voice Agent Button” block into the header in Appearance > Editor.

Does it work with Elementor and other page builders?

Yes. Add the shortcode [softvoltai_voice_agent] with the builder’s shortcode element, or any button with the CSS class svava-open.

Does it work with caching plugins?

Yes. The chat endpoint needs no nonce, so cached pages keep working. If an optimisation plugin removes footer scripts, set “Load the script in” to Header.

My security plugin turns off the REST API for visitors.

The agent notices and switches to admin-ajax.php automatically.

Can I send leads to Google Sheets, a CRM or WhatsApp?

Yes, through n8n, Make or Zapier. Turn on the webhook on the Alerts tab. The n8n tab has a ready-made workflow and a free hosting guide.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • New: hooks for add-ons. The svava_tools and svava_run_tool filters let an add-on give the agent more tools; the svava_pre_reply filter and the svava_chat_turn action let an add-on keep conversations or let a person answer, and the chat window has a small window.SVAVA API for showing a reply from a person on your team.
  • New: an n8n Templates page with ready-made workflows for your agent’s leads, with their prices in the SoftVoltAI store.
  • New: add-ons can put their screens in the Voice Agent top bar (svava_admin_page, svava_admin_nav, svava_pro_active).
  • The Pro page now shows what Voice Agent Pro adds and the AI credits add-on, with links to the plans and to a 3-day free trial of Pro.
  • The Voice Agent screens use the full width of the screen, and buttons look and line up the same on every screen.
  • The free plugin works exactly as before; nothing was removed or locked.

1.0.0

  • First release.
